title: Connection lab
hint_single_connect: Use Connect on only one PC. Both sides must be paired first.

peer_select.label: Target peer
peer_select.none_paired: No paired peers on the network.

keyboard.title: Keyboard mirror test
keyboard.hint: Captures keys for 5 seconds and sends them to the remote PC (open Notepad there to verify).
keyboard.hint_connect_side: Type on this PC (the one that pressed Connect). On the remote PC, open Notepad to see the text.
keyboard.warn_remote_no_inject: Frames are being sent but this PC shows no remote injections. On the remote PC, open Lab → Input debug and check remote_inject_ok.
keyboard.error_failed: Input test failed. Check that you are on the PC that initiated Connect.

debug.title: Input pipeline debug
debug.hint_two_pcs: On the remote PC, open this Lab page and refresh stats to see reception and injection (remote_inject_ok).
debug.hint_logs: For full traces: $env:WINX_LOG = "winx=debug" before starting the app.

errors.not_connected: Connect to the peer before running transport tests.
